WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, (SELECT net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c WHERE c.business_date = n.business_date AND c.store_id = 900) AS control
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH wl AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM wl) AS lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM wl GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_line,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM wl GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_id,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM wl) AS loads,
       (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at) FROM wl) AS min_load, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM wl) AS max_load,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wl l LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE o.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_order,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc>=TIMESTAMP '2025-12-14 22:00:00' AND dispatch_ts_utc<TIMESTAMP '2025-12-23 22:00:00') AS orders_in_window,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_orders;

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_day,
       count(*) AS orders,
       sum((status='delivered')::int) deliv, sum((status='collected')::int) coll, sum((status='processing')::int) proc, sum((status='cancelled')::int) canc,
       sum((dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL)::int) no_disp,
       sum((fulfilment_type='click_and_collect')::int) cc
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-12-10 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-26 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp_day, count(*) n, min(dispatch_ts_utc) mn, max(dispatch_ts_utc) mx, sum(order_total_gross) gross
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE dispatch_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-12-10 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-26 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 'lines_on_nondispatched_orders' k, count(*)::varchar v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_lines_web_dec', count(*)::varchar FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_store_ids_in_window', string_agg(DISTINCT s.store_id::varchar, ',') FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-12-14 22:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-23 22:00:00')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fully_loaded', string_agg(fiscal_period_label||':'||fully_loaded::varchar, ',') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_start_date<=DATE '2025-12-23' AND period_end_date>=DATE '2025-12-15'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_web_window', count(*)::varchar||' / '||sum(refund_net)::varchar FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_dup', count(*)::varchar FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'trading', string_agg(calendar_date::varchar||':'||is_trading_day::varchar||':'||coalesce(holiday_name,''), ' ') FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23';
